source_text:
9.4 ανονψμι ιν μς. παρισινο γρ. 2286 Ὡς δὲ Βαβυλώνιος ὁ
Ἀφρικανὸς φησὶν ὅτι εἰ θέλει παιδοποιῆσαι τις, πρὸ τῆς συνελεύσεως τῆς γυναικὸς
ἤγουν ὅταν μέλλῃ εἰς συνουσίαν ἐλθεῖν, ἐπιχρισάτω τὸ μόριον αὐτοῦ αἷμα λαγωοῦ
καὶ ποιήσει παῖδα ἄρρενα εἰ δὲ χήνειον στέαρ ἐπιχρίσει καὶ ποιήσει θῆλυ.
pass_a_gloss: 9.4 Anonymous in ms. Parisino gr. 2286. As but Babylonian the Africanus says that if he-wants to-beget-a-child someone, before the coming-together of-the-woman that-is when he-is-about into intercourse to-come, let-him-smear the member of-him blood of-a-hare and he-will-make a-child male; if but goose-fat he-should-smear also he-will-make female.
pass_b_english: Anonymous, in Paris manuscript gr. 2286. As the Babylonian Africanus says, if someone wants to beget a child, before coming together with the woman — that is, when he is about to come to intercourse — let him smear his member with hare’s blood and he will make a male child; but if he smears goose-fat he will make a female.

choices.why: The lock names him Babylonian here; do not drop it or turn it into a place of writing only.
rejected: Africanus of Babylon the city as a title
